tickerText: [TENNIS] Daniil Medvedev beat Andrey Rublev 7-5, 6-4 on Sept. 30 to win the Hangzhou Open for his 24th ATP title and third of 2026, while the Kinoshita Japan Open and China Open both open Sept. 30 with Stefanos Tsitsipas facing Tomas Martin Etcheverry in Tokyo • [SQUASH] India's women assured another Asian Games medal with a 2-0 team semifinal win over Singapore on Sept. 30 as Tanvi Khanna and Anahat Singh won singles, while the PSA's CB Squash Tour continues in São Paulo and the Champion Fiberglass Swedish Open debuts in Stockholm • [BADMINTON] An Se-young became the first woman to win back-to-back Asian Games singles gold with a 21-17, 21-9 final win over Akane Yamaguchi on Sept. 29, and Kunlavut Vitidsarn took men's gold 21-12, 21-16 over Singapore's Loh Kean Yew • [PICKLEBALL] The Rate Las Vegas Open moves to the pro round of 32 on Sept. 30 at the Darling Tennis Center as Anna Leigh Waters—at 198 career PPA titles and skipping singles—chases No. 200 in women's and mixed doubles with a near full-strength field back from Mesa • [TABLE TENNIS] Lin Shidong swept Wang Chuqin 4-0 in the Asian Games men's singles final to complete a triple-gold haul as China's table tennis program took six of seven golds, with Japan's men the lone upset winners in the team event

newsItems.title: Medvedev Wins Hangzhou Open
newsItems.excerpt: Daniil Medvedev defeated Andrey Rublev 7-5, 6-4 on Sept. 30 to capture the Hangzhou Open, his 24th career ATP title and a boost toward Turin as the Japan Open and China Open also kick off across Asia.

newsItems.title: An, Kunlavut Rule Asiad Singles
newsItems.excerpt: An Se-young routed Akane Yamaguchi 21-17, 21-9 on Sept. 29 for a historic second straight Asian Games women's singles gold, while Kunlavut Vitidsarn beat Loh Kean Yew for Thailand's first men's singles title.

newsItems.title: Vegas Open Hits Round of 32
newsItems.excerpt: The Carvana PPA Tour's Rate Las Vegas Open advances to pro round-of-32 play on Sept. 30 with $1 million-plus on the line as Anna Leigh Waters, two titles shy of 200, targets both doubles draws without entering singles.

newsItems.title: Lin's Triple Gold In Nagoya
newsItems.excerpt: China's Lin Shidong blanked Wang Chuqin 4-0 in the Asian Games men's singles final to finish with three gold medals as the nation's paddlers claimed six of seven titles after Japan's historic men's team upset.
